text:
Hana L: quick follow-up from the embeddings latency postmortem — capturing owners and tiny PRs to reduce alert noise and avoid pages during transient model warmups.
Mikkel O: saw a burst of rerank-time pages when the new embed-model rolled. alerts fired per-route because thresholds were static and didn’t account for initial cold KV-cache behavior.
Gina P: root cause summary in the doc: cold KV cache + heavy re-ranking requests + per-variant alert thresholds. link: https://redwood.internal/pm/embeddings-warmup
Hana L: proposed action items (small, testable): 1) add a short warmup cooldown for embed-route token-rate alert (owner: Mikkel O, ETA: 48h); 2) change alert fingerprinting to include model_variant and route but ignore ephemeral request_id to avoid duplicates (owner: Gina P, ETA: 72h); 3) create a suppression-candidate job that lists alerts firing >=5 times in 24h and surfaces them for manual review (owner: Hana L, ETA: 10 days).
Mikkel O: ack. for (1) I'll add a 4m initial cooldown window for routes that just deployed model-variant flips, plus a metric tag that marks "warmup" state. will include replay test.
Gina P: ack. for (2) I'll change the fingerprint logic and add a feature flag. example change:```yaml
alert_dedupe:
  window_seconds: 120
  fingerprint_keys: [model_variant, route, error_hash]
  exclude_keys: [request_id]
```
Hana L: for (3) the suppression job will post candidates to #alerts-review and create a card in the postmortem board. we will NOT auto-suppress without human approval.
AlertBot: INCIDENT-8302 resolved. Tag follow-up owners to the incident.
Mikkel O: also adding a monitoring metric "embed_warmup_alert_rate" so we can measure post-rollout noise before broad rollout. owner: Mikkel O, ETA: 1 week.
Gina P: I'll add unit tests asserting that dedupe groups across AZs for identical error_hashes and that request_id doesn't break grouping. branch: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-embed-fingerprint
Hana L: created board card and scheduled a 15m check-in in 48h to verify PRs land. optional safety: do a 10% canary for suppression candidates to validate false-negative risk. owner: Hana L, ETA: 2 weeks.
Mikkel O: PR for cooldown + warmup tagging opened: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/3012 — includes load replay and expected graphs.
Gina P: dedupe FF branch created and unit tests added: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-embed-120s
Hana L: thanks everyone. closing thread once PRs are merged and the suppression-job posts its first weekly list. ping me if you need help. :white_check_mark:
